name: Augendopler family
note: Founding and owner family of backaldrin International The Kornspitz Company GmbH (Asten, Austria; founded 1964 by Alois and Juliana Augendopler with son Peter). The company's team page names 'The Owning Family: Peter Augendopler sen. with Peter Augendopler jun. and Regina Augendopler'. No register entry naming shareholdings was opened, so parentId is null.
